brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested two Palestinians on Sunday during a road stop in the Jenin area, Shehab Wire reported. A special Israeli military unit detained Hamza Ahmad Salatneh and Mahmoud Khalilieh as they traveled by vehicle along the Sanur-Jaba road south of the city. The arrests occurred during daylight hours on the main route between the two towns.

Local sources confirmed the detention by the occupation force, though the circumstances leading to their arrest and their current whereabouts remained undisclosed. The incident marked another in a series of arrests in the northern West Bank region, where Israeli military operations have intensified in recent months.
